name: gearshift
description: Model and effort routing for Claude Code. Sends each subagent to the cheapest model tier and effort level that will finish its task, with pinned subagents, an enforcing hook, a usage ledger and a warning before a cache-dropping model switch.

mode.title: Routing mode
mode.description: off, shadow (log only), fill (set model and effort where the Agent call left them unset), or strict (also replace a model the orchestrator chose)

ceiling.title: Highest tier the hook may assign
ceiling.description: session (never above the model you are running), haiku, sonnet, opus or fable

announce.title: Announce routed subagents
announce.description: Show a one-line note each time the hook routes a subagent

advise.title: Session model advice
advise.description: Show a one-line note on a clear mismatch between the session model and the work, and before a model switch that drops the prompt cache

judge.title: Judge model
judge.description: Second opinion from Haiku when the keyword rules are unsure: auto (on if GEARSHIFT_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set), off, api, or claude (headless Claude Code on your login, slower)
